The [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''grandfather''' of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dorja]] was an [[Republic officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] at some point in his life, as were four preceding generations of the [[Dorja family]] before him. The [[Gender/Legends|man's]] [[Dorja's father|son]] and grandson followed suit, and his great-granddaughter [[Vana Dorja]] became a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="DFR Sourcebook ">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>
